notes: Particle burst wrapper. Wraps any child (Button, Link, Card, raw element) and fires a particle burst on click or hover. Particle visual is a Shape config — rendered to a hidden <template> at build time, cloned per particle at runtime. Two engines: fly (Web Animations, fade-out) and physics (gravity + AABB collision against page text + optional cursor magnet). Modules import globally via BaseLayout. In textonly the wrapper still renders so children survive — runtime gates auto-init via render-mode check.

_rules.note: palette='tiers' cycles through 4 tiers of brandColor. Without brandColor there's nothing to cycle.
palette='rainbow' ignores brandColor/rainbowColor; palette='tiers' uses brandColor but ignores colorTier and rainbowColor (cycles instead).
gravity/magnet/collide only meaningful when engine='physics' — runtime ignores them otherwise.

particle._description: Particle visual — Shape or Icon config. Build-time rendered into a hidden template; cloned per particle at runtime. Shape covers primitives, D1 logos via slug, custom SVG. Icon renders Phosphor glyphs directly. When palette is set, the particle renders multiple times — once per palette colour.

colour._description: Single brand colour for every particle. Mutually exclusive with palette.

brandColor.description: Brand-scale colour applied uniformly to every particle.

colorTier.description: Tier modifier for brandColor. Ignored when palette='tiers' (which cycles all four).

rainbow._description: Single rainbow colour for every particle. Mutually exclusive with palette.

palette._description: Multi-particle colour cycle — runtime picks a different palette colour per particle.

palette.description: tiers: cycles particles through tint/mid/base/emphasis of brandColor (4 colours). rainbow: cycles particles through rainbow-1..rainbow-7 (7 colours).

engine.description: fly: outward burst, fade out (Web Animations). physics: gravity, AABB collision against page text/buttons, optional cursor magnet.

trigger.description: click: fire on click (links delay nav 400ms). hover: fire on first mouseenter, retrigger after 2s.

spread.description: Spread radius in px (fly) or horizontal scatter (physics).

lifespan.description: Particle lifetime in ms before fade-out.

physics._description: Physics engine knobs — engine='physics' only, ignored otherwise

gravity.description: Vertical acceleration in px/frame². Higher = particles fall faster.

magnet.description: Particles attract toward cursor while alive.

collide.description: Particles stop on contact with p/h1/h2/h3/button/a rects (text 'lands' on words). Set false to fall to viewport floor only.
